decisions.statement: A set is worth the load that set moves once for each rep.
The load a set moves counts the weight once for each implement held.
The load a set moves counts the share of the bodyweight the exercise has.
How much of the lifter's own weight a movement carries is the movement's to state.
The bodyweight is read off Alan's own page.
The movement is reached by the address the set names rather than by a slug.
A set's volume is not rounded.
A field the set states nothing for counts as nought rather than refusing.
A set is worth the load it moved, whether that set warmed Alan up or worked him.
A set carrying no load and a set counting no rep come out at nought on the arithmetic alone.

definition: the weight one set of work moved, in pounds
